About Me

Cloud & Infrastructure Automation Support Engineer

I'm a Cloud & Infrastructure Automation Engineer with 3+ years of experience supporting enterprise-scale infrastructure across AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform (GCP). At HCL Tech, I supported multi-cloud infrastructure operations in an enterprise medical domain environment — VM lifecycle management, Chef automation support, Jenkins CI/CD troubleshooting, incident management, technical diagnosis, and coordination with DevOps and engineering teams. I focus on structured troubleshooting, reliable infrastructure operations, and improving repeatable workflows to help teams deliver infrastructure more efficiently.
